basic_info.description: This Charming Edwardian home situated on a picturesque, tree-lined street blends timeless elegance with incredible space. Enter the foyer and you are greeted by a custom-built bench and gorgeous refinished hardwood floors. The spacious banquet-sized dining room, adorned with recessed French doors and an original casement window, is flooded with natural light perfect for entertaining. The formal living room exudes classic charm with its wood-burning fireplace, built-in bookshelves, triple crown molding and stunning stained-glass windows that add a cozy, refined touch. The expansive kitchen offers seamless functionality with a passthrough to the dining room and direct access to a delightful sunlit breakfast room, powder room, and a side door leading to the backyard, perfect for outdoor entertainment. The upper level boasts three generously sized bedrooms, a full split bathroom and a charming sunroom. The primary bedroom includes a convenient powder room (potential for full bath and walk-in closet). The large backyard provides an ideal space for relaxation or entertainment. The 2-car garage w/ample storage adds coveted convenience. Ideally located near the vibrant shopping & dining of Geary & Clement Streets, Argonne Elementary School, UCSF, and the iconic Golden Gate Park!
